That's _almost_ fixed.. it's already been pointed out to LSJ that this
wording allows you to MFG (or use Gisela's special to burn) other,
non-minion cards in the uncontrolled region such as Gather or Tomb of
Ramses - and 'crypt card' doesn't work as a fix, because of things like
Banished Waters of Duat/Embrace/etc.

"Minion" or "minion card" were suggested to LSJ as fixes in the end of
the discussion, so this'll probably get adjusted on all the cards that
had the Legacies-timed 'vampire' -> 'card' fix in the near future.

-John Flournoy

And thus the problem with attempting to have one conversation in two
places.

The actual resolution was "uncontrolled minion in your prey's
uncontrolled region" (in Gisela's case, similar for other cases).

This will be reflected in the next card list -- and note that the
actual function of the card is not changed (the current use of "card"
being just a clarification and not representing a functional change).

Thus: nothing to report. Sorry for the confusion.

For those of you still confused by this issue, just ignore the
diversion given in this thread and play the cards the way the NoR
preview page says to.
